name: Psionic Sunder [Psionic]
body:
You can draw on your psionic power to boost the power of a sunder attack.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a sunder combat maneuver, you also deal damage equal to half your level to the creature holding the item sundered.

If you expend your psionic focus when you perform a successful sunder maneuver, you ignore half the hardness of the object you are sundering.
